audit_scope: Documentation-only audit; only docs/product/backend-salvage.json and docs/product/backend-salvage.md written. No credentials inspected, providers invoked, data copied, git mutation, commit or deployment.

approved_target.precedence: Approved behavioral brief and explicit user decisions override source bugs, old integration-map pending-decision text and marketing claims.

approved_target.authentication: Supabase Auth email+password selected; replaces prior OTP implementation. Preserve Discord/Google OAuth and safe linking behavior as independently gated integrations. Do not port NextAuth/scrypt JSON storage.
approved_target.money: Stripe checkout/webhook and Stripe Connect planned, NOT configured/verified by this audit. No source paid/tip/Paid record proves funds.

findings.finding: paid, tip and Paid are local records, not payment collection, confirmed tips or actual payouts. placeOrder trusts browser total/category/title.
findings.required_action: Server-owned quote and verified payment webhook; immutable payment and payout events with idempotency, reconciliation and explicit live-money enablement.

findings.finding: accept checks queued status before awaiting accessOf; overlapping calls can both pass then overwrite assignment. Other completion/review/report/wallet operations have await gaps; process globals do not provide cross-instance consistency.
findings.required_action: Database transaction/row locking and conditional state updates, unique active assignment/open-customer order/event keys; concurrency tests.

findings.finding: JSON/global stores and queued save promises acknowledge before durable commit and may log write failure while returning success. Several loaders recover corrupt files as empty.
findings.required_action: Do not import store implementation into runtime. Postgres transactions/RLS/backup/restore, private object storage, durable outbox and clear failure semantics.

findings.finding: Audit recording is a separate admin POST; operational services do not automatically append it. Brief demand every admin action is not actually guaranteed by source.
findings.required_action: Write authenticated actor/action/detail in same transaction as every privileged mutation, never rely on UI follow-up.

findings.finding: Deposits release on elapsed time only, not absence of dispute. Report approval records €50 owed but has no bounty payout/credit implementation.
findings.required_action: Dispute hold entity and release eligibility; explicit one-time bounty liability and reviewed settlement path.

findings.finding: Friday grouping uses server-local timezone and fixed 7-day milliseconds; late review tips mutate entries in original completion week, potentially changing Paid totals.
findings.required_action: Explicit Europe/Vienna civil-week semantics with DST tests; separate tip/adjustment events by settlement date and immutable paid statements.

findings.finding: Wrong-game claim GET returns order payload with blocked reason; game-toggle filter affects presence/misses, not deskState queue; Discord queue embeds disclose auto-cancel deadline to teammates.
findings.required_action: Approved server visibility policy wins over source leaks; redact blocked claim entirely, consistently enforce queue game preferences and remove timing from teammate notifications.

findings.finding: Catalog has 15 games/162 normalized services and 45 bundle names; learn half-price is unconditional source catalog pricing. Wingman ladder minimum .75 is an exception to brief approximate .8 range.
findings.required_action: Retain exact catalog/ranks, apply first-session entitlement on server to only one eligible session, validate rank rather than silent fallback; retain Teams content but disable unsupported multi-seat fulfillment.

findings.finding: FAQ markets PRO membership and favourites/direct rebooking, trust perk labels imply automatic matching perks, and creator calculator describes unimplemented attribution. Legal text promises provider/retention behavior not established by implementation.
findings.required_action: Preserve as source evidence, not feature claims. Approved brief is target; user email+password Supabase overrides OTP. Remove unsupported claims before launch and verify legal/merchant facts.

findings.finding: Magic/size checks and filename restrictions are useful, but avatar dimensions rely on browser, upload URL ownership is not checked by profile regex, and body sizes are not bounded before base64 decode.
findings.required_action: Server re-encode/size/dimension quotas, storage object ownership binding, rollback/outbox cleanup, private evidence ACLs, no-store evidence serving.

findings.finding: ledger comment claims orders are trimmed to400 but actual orders.save keeps every order; wallet history recomputes cashback with creation-order/current constants rather than immutable earned postings.
findings.required_action: Use executable behavior not stale comments; persist policy/version and completion-ordered rewards, gifts and refund reversals in ledger.

findings.finding: Source boot creates per-process timers and WebSocket worker; global singleton cannot prevent duplicate bots in multiple deployments or posts sent before persistence.
findings.required_action: Dedicated single-leased worker, durable scheduling/outbox/reconciliation; do not boot from Astro serverless routes or preview.

dependency_sequence.acceptance: Supabase email+password signup/login/confirmation/reset; OAuth configured separately; fresh server roles; owner immutability; no role from user metadata; account RLS tested on disposable DB.
15 games/162 services retained; quantities/discounts, rank variants, first-session eligibility, mid/markup snapshots; no money moved; Teams disabled until seat model.

Tables/constraints/RLS for orders, assignments, payments/events, wallet postings/reservations, chat, access, ledger, payouts, reports, flags, applications, support, audit; private storage ACL; atomic commands and outbox.

Server-owned quote + actor/order limit + wallet reservation; signed webhook verifies amount/currency/provider intent; one event one order, retries recover; test mode only before live-money authorization.

One atomic winner, one active assignment; authoritative deadlines even without viewers; expiry wallet credit once; visibility history/miss rules; private realtime with server projections; Discord-link eligibility.

Participant-only chat; filter before publish; proof ownership/limits; two 5-minute rerolls archive chat; completion+ledger+rewards transaction; review once; tip only on provider confirmation; report decision/bounty liability.

EUR/USD immutable postings; historical reward policy and no double gifts; dispute-aware 14-day release; explicit Friday Europe/Vienna boundaries; immutable settled payout rows; provider sandbox reconciliation before live payouts.

Durable rate limiting; one pending application/open conversation; approval transaction; own-data Sparky; guest cookie isolation; every admin action audit; email delivery is independently configured/verified.
One leased worker outside serverless; durable outbox/dedupe; mock gateway/REST failure tests; explicit provider credentials/guild/permissions approved; disabled preview side effects.

Real merchant/legal/contact and privacy facts; financial/legal approval; provider test-mode acceptance plus explicit live-money gate; creator tracking and multi-seat work remain separate, never silently inferred from old UI.
